marta: Heads-up — planning RBAC change for private deployments tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need signoff on keystore/KMS access model and audit hooks. :eyes:

jonathan: Can you summarize the change? which roles are affected?

marta: TL;DR: split `infra-admin` into `infra-operator` (no KMS unwrap) and `infra-admin` (keystore/KMS admin). Goal: reduce blast radius for on-prem teams.

liam: How will this affect existing service accounts? migration plan?

marta: We'll rotate service-account keys and introduce an attestation step for onprem nodes. Migration script will: create new roles, map existing SAs to infra-operator, schedule key-rotation with KMS unwrap audit. ETA 1 week.

eva: Important: need audit logs for both KMS unwrap and KMS decrypt events. Our compliance requires 90d retention + immutability.

audit-bot: REMINDER: KMS events must be sent to secure-logs cluster. Use `secure-logs://keystore-events` endpoint.

jonathan: For network isolation, do we have NetPol to ensure only onprem control-plane can call KMS endpoint?

liam: Proposed netpol snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-controlplane-kms
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: kms-proxy
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: control-plane
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

marta: That helps. Also require mTLS between proxy and KMS HSM. ops will validate with attest tool.

eva: Can we add detection for repeated unwrap failures? e.g., >10 fails in 5m => alert -> incident. :rotating_light:

jonathan: Add to runbook: block and rotate keys if we see >50 failed unwraps from single identity.

liam: Will we log plaintext or only metadata? Must avoid PII in logs.

marta: Log only metadata: requestor identity, operation (unwrap/decrypt), key id, status, timestamp, error codes. No payload or plaintext.

eva: Final question: do we need key splitting with KMS and local HSM for highest regs?

marta: For now optional. We'll propose hybrid for customers requiring dual custody. Needs legal review.

jonathan: SGTM. I'll run a small canary in sandbox at 10:00 today. @marta can you drop the migration script link?

marta: link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/keystore-migration/commit/4a7b :thumbsup:

liam: Noted. I'll add netpol lint to CI and a preflight check for audit-forwarding.

audit-bot: deploy-checklist: roles-created:true, audit-forwarding:true, netpol-lint:warn

marta: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD I'll kick the rollout.
